integrity: The general proof is symbolic. The exhaustive computation is used only as an independent finite check of the displayed six-vertex complex and explicit low-order witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the minimum vertex number and the unique minimum combinatorial type for triangulations of the two-sphere.
It does not classify larger fixed-simplex sphere triangulations or determine higher-dimensional minima.
The literature search found no statement of the exact six-vertex cutoff, but unindexed prior appearances remain a residual originality risk.
title: Six vertices are minimal for a fixed-simplex triangulation of the two-sphere
